text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Pembangunan Kemahiran Kebangsaan (Penepian Fi kepada Pelatih

di Pusat Bertauliah) 2018.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 November 2017.

Penepian fi

2. (1) Tertakluk kepada subperaturan (2), fi yang ditetapkan dalam butiran 1(a)(i)

Jadual Kedua kepada Peraturan-Peraturan Pembangunan Kemahiran Kebangsaan

(Fi dan Caj) 2016 [P.U. (A) 86/2016] diketepikan berkenaan dengan seseorang pelatih

yang memohon bagi pengiktirafan kemahiran yang membawa kepada anugerah

Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia melalui pusat bertauliah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual.

(2) Penepian fi di bawah subperaturan (1) terpakai bagi permohonan

pengiktirafan kemahiran yang dibuat dalam tempoh tiga tahun dari 1 November 2017

hingga 31 Oktober 2020.

JADUAL

 Pusat Bertauliah

1. Montfort Boys Town, Shah Alam

2. Montfort Youth Training Centre, Kota Kinabalu

3. Science of Life Studies 24/7, Segambut

Dibuat2 Mei 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/16/1; PN(PU2)655/V]

DATO' SRI (DR.) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT ACT 2006

NATIONAL SKILLS DEVELOPMENT

(WAIVER OF FEE TO TRAINEE AT ACCREDITED CENTRE) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 72(2)(d) of the

National Skills Development Act 2006 [Act 652], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the National Skills Development

(Waiver of Fee to Trainee at Accredited Centre) Regulations 2018.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation

on 1 November 2017.

Waiver of fee

2. (1) Subject to subregulation (2), the fee prescribed in item 1(a)(i) of the

Second Schedule to the National Skills Development (Fees and Charges)

Regulations 2016 [P.U. (A) 86/2016] is waived in respect of a trainee who applies for the

recognition of skills leading to the award of the Malaysian Skills Certificate through the

accredited centre as specified in the Schedule.

(2) The waiver of fee under subregulation (1) applies to the application for the

recognition of skills made within the period of three years from 1 November 2017

to 31 October 2020.

SCHEDULE

 Accredited Centre

1. Montfort Boys Town, Shah Alam

2. Montfort Youth Training Centre, Kota Kinabalu

3. Science of Life Studies 24/7, Segambut

Made 2 May 2018

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/2/16/1; PN(PU2)655/V]

DATO' SRI (DR.) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Minister of Human Resources
